project.name: frappe-framework
project.description: Core framework components for the Rust ERPNext rewrite.

llm_context.architecture_notes: This workspace acts as the engine, providing the multi-tenant HTTP/3 network layer (frappe-net), dynamic SurrealQL schema compiler (frappe-meta), content-addressed storage (frappe-storage), and sandboxed Rhai scripting engine with AST caching.
